title: Referrals and Authorizations Fresh Facility Bill Hold for Inpatient Closures
content:
When the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime is confirmed under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a fresh facility bill holds a day.

## Evidence on file

- The facility's most recent claim line under the authorization: the TRICARE Prime claim line billed under it with the latest posted date, and how many days ago it was posted.
- Whether any use is posted in the authorization's unit history.

## Schedule of holds

| Facility's most recent line under the authorization | Use already posted | Days held |
|---|---|---|
| posted no more than 3 days ago | yes | 1 |
| posted no more than 3 days ago | no | 2 |
| posted more than 3 days ago, or no line | any | 0 |

In words: where the facility's most recent claim line under the authorization was posted no more than three days ago and a use is already posted, one day is held; where such a line was posted no more than three days ago and no use is posted yet, two days are held; otherwise nothing is held.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical; closure confirmed on 12 June)

- Line posted 9 June (3 days before), a use posted: 1 day held.
- Line posted 9 June, no use posted: 2 days held.
- Line posted 8 June (4 days before): nothing held.
